data.short_meaning: One who is famous for sacred knowledge
data.long_meaning: Derived from the roots 'sruta' (heard) and 'kirt' (fame), the name Srutakirt signifies one who is renowned for their sacred knowledge. The name Srutakirt carries the meaning “One who is famous for sacred knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Srutakirt usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is famous for sacred knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Srutakirt belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is famous for sacred knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Srutakirt total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
